claims.text: The approach improves interpretability by soliciting informative keywords from the crowd, which provide human-understandable explanations for the model's predictions.
By leveraging crowd workers to identify new keywords based on model disagreements, the approach enhances transparency in how the model learns and makes predictions.
The iterative process of obtaining keyword-specific expectations from the crowd allows for continuous improvement in model performance and interpretability.
